flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui: pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx (existing report tabs), pages/Report/lists/ReportListDOS.tsx (commented out), tagged-vehicle route and menu (commented out). ocmsadminprivateapi: CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl only records a record count into batch_job. No tagging, hitlist, or DOS report.
note: Story status is blank in stories.json; assessed from the story text. None of the four reports named by the story exists (records in tagging files to enforcement/EPS, tagged vehicles/IDs sent to DOS, details received from DOS, records added/removed from hitlists). Hitlist as data does not exist (OCMS33.4), there is no DOS integration (OCMS33.5/33.6), and the staff Report page has no tagging tab. The only reusable foundation is the generic Report page with download for other agencies (LTA, MHA, VHUB) and the Wanted Vehicle record count in the batch_job log (%s). A 'DOS' tab exists but is commented out (%s), and its grid uses the dosvaultrecords resource with no controller and lists vault query rows (NPA/Get Particulars), not a tagging report. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. No relevant maintenance ticket.
recommendation: Do not claim. Tagging, hitlist, and DOS reports are not built; the generic Report page is not the report the story names

steps.step: OCMS generates a report of the records in the tagging files sent to frontend enforcement systems and EPS operators
steps.detail: There is no report on the file content. The CES job only records the record count as batch_job log text (ocmsadminprivateapi/src/main/java/com/ocmsintranet/cronservice/framework/services/ces/CesWantedVehicleServiceImpl.java:64); there is no record list and no CES tab on the Report page. The staff Report page has tabs for NOTICE-FE, RIP, NOTICE-CRE, LTA, VHUB, MHA, ENOTIF, HIVE_CONTACT, REMINDER, CPS, PS, DH_FIN, DH_UEN (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx:52-144); there is no tagging, CES, or SPMS tab. The NOTICE-FE tab (ReportList.tsx:52-57) lists notices created by enforcement systems (inbound), not outgoing tagging files. EPS does not exist in code.

steps.step: OCMS generates a report of tagged vehicles/IDs sent to DOS
steps.detail: Nothing is sent to DOS and there is no report for it. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo. There is no tagging/hitlist entity, repository, service, or screen in the six repos (grep for hitlist, tagging, tagged, SPMS, season parking returns nothing in source). The only leftovers are the commented-out 'Tagged Vehicle' route and menu (ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx:326-329; ocmsadminui/src/utils/data/LinkData.tsx:406; ocmsadminui/src/utils/Meta/TaggedVehicle.ts:1-12) and a translation label (ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:167-169).

steps.step: OCMS generates a report of the details received from DOS
steps.detail: No data is received from DOS. A 'DOS Reports' screen exists (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportListDOS.tsx:82) but its tab is commented out (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx:162-166), the dosvaultrecords resource has no controller in any repo, and its columns are Query Stage/Query Type (NPA = Vehicle Ownership), so it is not a tagging report. DOS = DataHive/LTA cannot be confirmed from the repo.

steps.step: OCMS generates a report of records added to or removed from the hitlists
steps.detail: There is no hitlist as data, so there is no add/remove log to report. There is no tagging/hitlist entity, repository, service, or screen in the six repos (grep for hitlist, tagging, tagged, SPMS, season parking returns nothing in source). The only leftovers are the commented-out 'Tagged Vehicle' route and menu (ocmsadminui/src/App.tsx:326-329; ocmsadminui/src/utils/data/LinkData.tsx:406; ocmsadminui/src/utils/Meta/TaggedVehicle.ts:1-12) and a translation label (ocmsadminui/src/i18n/en/translation.json:167-169).

steps.step: The tagging officer downloads the tagging reports from the staff portal
steps.detail: There is no tagging report to download. A report-with-download mechanism exists for other agencies, but not for the report the story names. The staff Report page has tabs for NOTICE-FE, RIP, NOTICE-CRE, LTA, VHUB, MHA, ENOTIF, HIVE_CONTACT, REMINDER, CPS, PS, DH_FIN, DH_UEN (ocmsadminui/src/pages/Report/lists/ReportList.tsx:52-144); there is no tagging, CES, or SPMS tab. Not counted as Sebagian because none of the requested report content exists.
